programme.title: Лица времени. Остров надежды (полный фильм)
programme.desc: Рассказ о региональной общественной организации «Христианская Ассоциация служения осужденным». Многие освободившиеся заключенные находят здесь приют и заботу. Сотрудники Ассоциации помогают им изменить жизнь. Многие из тех, кто находит здесь приют, создают семьи. Председатель организации – Николай Либенко. Он – архитектор и писатель. Более 30-ти лет Николай Назарович помогает бывшим заключенным. В этом служении он нашел свое призвание. В Ассоциацию за помощью может обратиться любой человек, когда-либо бывший в заключении. Ведущий: Николай Назарович Либенко, председатель Тульской региональной общественной организации «Христианская Ассоциация служения осужденным»

Что делать в этом случае? Гость программы рассказывает свою историю о том, как он, раз за разом обращаясь к Богу за помощью, получал помощь и направление в решении проблемы, выстраивал живые отношения с Ним. Как не терять веру в это: ведь время идет, а Христос не приходит, хотя и обещал это 2000 лет назад. Почему Он медлит? Истории из Ветхого Завета показывают нам, какую жизнь Бог готовит для нас и чего Он от нас ожидает. Бог хочет, чтобы мы проявляли верность Ему. Ведущий: Вячеслав Бучнев, священнослужитель

programme.title: В гостях у ТРК «Три Ангела». Разворот на 180: от атеизма к вере
programme.desc: Человек становится верующим. Три слова, но за ними стоит большая работа Бога над сердцем этого человека, молитвы окружающих и непростая внутренняя работа самого человека. Человек становится верующим, и это всегда неизбежно влечет изменение его жизни, от пищевых привычек до вечной участи. Анвар Гиндуллин рассказывает свою историю о том, как, будучи выходцем из атеистической семьи, стал священнослужителем. Ведущий: Анна Богатская, Гость: Анвар Гиндуллин, священнослужитель

programme.title: Реальный Бог. Рождение поэта
programme.desc: Татьяна, член союза литераторов России, начала писать стихи ещё в школе. Позже, придя в церковь, она услышала духовные стихотворения и начала молиться о том, чтобы прославлять в своём творчестве Создателя. Бог благословил Татьяну и в её жизни произошло много удивительных опытов! Ведущий: Татьяна Кувичинская

programme.desc: Каждый человек, проживая свою жизнь, приобретает тот или иной опыт, в том числе, личный опыт веры, опыт взаимоотношений с Богом. Даже если кажется, что его нет, он есть. На основании прежде всего собственного опыта человек делает выводы и составляет мнение о вещах и явлениях. Какой опыт с Богом надо постараться приобрести, чтобы правильно Его себе представлять? В каком случае мозг человека больше усваивает? Что лучше для интеллектуального развития человека? Как быть знающим, а не информированным? Ведущий: Андрей Юнак, Гость: Павел Жуков, священнослужитель

Какие существуют критерии успешности в жизни с Богом? Свою историю рассказывает священнослужитель Вениамин Дашкевич. programme.desc: Чтобы организовать грандиозный праздник для большого количества людей – инвалидов, больных, жертв насилия, – нужно проделать колоссальную работу и организовать большое количество людей. Но Роман захотел сделать для них нечто особенное – подарить мороженое, которое, как в детской песенке, привезёт вертолёт. Как у него получилось? Ведущий: Роман Седов

programme.title: Веселая школа здоровья. Гендерное воспитание дошкольников
programme.desc: Многие люди живут по принципу: «Все лучшее детям». Что же нужно ребенку для счастья? Может быть это новый айфон, необычное лего, кукольный домик, популярные игрушки? Вовсе нет. Главное для ребенка – внимание родителей. Счастье для ребенка – это мама и папа. Семья – главный фактор в гендерном воспитании детей, где папа является образцом мужского поведения, а мама – женского поведения. Ведущий: Михаил Севастьянов, Татьяна Малышева, Гость: Самуил Баринов, Настя Жукова

programme.title: Творение учит нас. Королевские пингвины. Никогда не сдаться
Верую. Христианское терпение
programme.desc: Почему терпение в христианской жизни так важно? Почему Бог часто несправедлив к грешникам? Он терпит, а не наказывает. В трудностях важно сохранять спокойствие и быть терпеливым. Ведущий: Андрей Юнак, священнослужитель

programme.title: Библия. Лютер и Библия
programme.desc: Многосерийный фильм «Библия». Протестантская Реформация в 2017 году отметила свой 500-летний юбилей. Мартин Лютер, с именем которого неразрывно связано это историческое событие, перевел Библию на немецкий язык и дал право толковать Священное Писание каждому человеку. Какие принципы Реформации провозгласил Лютер? Кто в истории России первым перевел Библию на родной язык и тем самым внес большой вклад в духовное развитие страны? Ведущий: Иван Лобанов, ведущий научный сотрудник Института перевода Библии им. М. П.Кулакова, Гость: А. Десницкий, доктор филологических наук, профессор РАН, Ю. Друми, доктор богословия, Н. Шабуров, профессор, директор Центра Изучения Религий РГГУ, о. игумен Иннокентий (Павлов), кандидат богословия, член правления РБО, С. Ряховский, Начальствующий Епископ Российского объединенного союза христиан веры евангельской, член Совета по взаимодействию с религиозными объединениями при Президенте РФ, Н. Гузов

programme.desc: В последнее время много видов мошенничества: вымогание денег, финансовые пирамиды, взломанные страницы в социальных сетях. Люди воруют деньги, время, идеи, вещи. Но Бог в Священном Писании повелел своему народу: не кради. Почему люди воруют? Можно ли обворовать Бога? programme.desc: Что может быть важнее, чем вера в себя? Ты потратил много времени на свое дело, но все было напрасно. Родственники, друзья, кажется, что все вокруг добились успеха и счастливы. programme.title: Открытая Книга. «В последние времена отступят некоторые от веры»
programme.desc: «В последние времена отступят некоторые от веры», – предупреждал апостол Павел. Он говорил не о далеком будущем, а о тенденции, которая уже началась. Какие обольщения нас ждут? Почему речь идет даже о запретах в браке и пище? Как отличить истинное учение от лукавого? Это не страшилка, а практическое руководство по духовной безопасности: как устоять в вере, когда даже проповедники могут заблуждаться. Ведущий: Юлия Синицына, Гость: Иван Вельгоша, священнослужитель

programme.desc: В Библии Богом оставлено повеление любить врагов. Но разве это не противоестественно – любить того, кто причиняет зло? Что значит любить врагов? Надо ли христианину ломать себя, чтобы исполнить эту заповедь? Как правильно любить врагов? Ведущий: Валерий Малышев, Гость: Вениамин Дашкевич, священнослужитель

programme.desc: Вечеря Господня в современной церкви – это участие в принятии символов тела и крови Христа, чтобы стать частью Христа, частью церкви, в которой присутствует Бог. Так понимают этот обряд в адвентистской церкви. Кто может принимать участие в вечери и надо ли к ней как-то готовиться? Ведущий: Александр Синицын, священнослужитель

programme.title: Мастерская добрых дел. Конкурс на звание лучшего дворника (Иоанн Креститель) / Божий спецагент
programme.desc: У Бога когда-то был особый человек, которому Он поручил специальную и непростую миссию – подготовить Израильский народ к приходу Мессии. Его звали Иоанн, и его рождение, так же, как и рождение Иисуса Христа, было необычным: о нем возвестил будущим родителям Божий посланник Гавриил. Иоанн как Божий спецагент хорошо справился с поручением Господа, но только потому, что удалялся от зла и пороков мира. Бог может дать поручение любому человеку, поэтому мы тоже всегда должны оставаться чистыми сердцем и верными Господу. Ведущий: Михаил Севастьянов, Гость: Влад Лапшин, Аня Малышева

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is the largest marine protected area in in Europe. Capraia is the third largest island of the archipelago and is located with its small harbor in the channel in front of Corsica. The island is an autonomous municipality with about 300 inhabitants. It is also considered the most maritime island of the archipelago. At the end of the eighties, the penal colony on Capraia was closed was closed and the island opened to tourism.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard Depardieu and his wife Carole Bouquet bought to produce traditional liqueur and nutmeg wine themselves and distribute it worldwide. The cuisine of the island is as much Arabic as Italian, couscous with fish is a typical island dish.

programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola. Only on Monte Isola there is a regular bus service in the summertime. Thus, the three islands are an oasis of an oasis of tranquility most of the year. The historical buildings and the nature remind of the long tradition in which the Italians have cultivated this retreat. Only every five years in the autumn a big celebration takes place. Then over 200,000 paper flowers decorate the island. The flowers are reminiscent of the time in the Middle Ages when a Roma woman brought her son to the island to be cured from the from the rampant plague. In gratitude, she donated a sea of flowers. The Festa di Santa Croce has been one of the main attractions in northern Italy ever since. The days are radiant with color, it is the only time when it gets crowded in the small streets of the island villages. The next festival was celebrated in September 2021.

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is the largest marine protected area in in Europe. Capraia is the third largest island of the archipelago and is located with its small harbor in the channel in front of Corsica. The island is an autonomous municipality with about 300 inhabitants. It is also considered the most maritime island of the archipelago. At the end of the eighties, the penal colony on Capraia was closed was closed and the island opened to tourism.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard Depardieu and his wife Carole Bouquet bought to produce traditional liqueur and nutmeg wine themselves and distribute it worldwide. The cuisine of the island is as much Arabic as Italian, couscous with fish is a typical island dish.

programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: 45 Minuten Thüringen
programme.desc: In einer Koproduktion der lokalen TV-Sender in Thüringen bringt Moderator Mike Langer Politik ganz nah an die Menschen. In jeder Folge trifft er auf Politikakteure oder -beobachter aus dem Freistaat Thüringen und beleuchtet nicht nur die politischen Themen der Region, sondern auch die Persönlichkeiten hinter den Entscheidungen.Was bewegt die Menschen, die über Thüringens Zukunft entscheiden? Welche Geschichten und Erfahrungen prägen ihre Arbeit? ?45 Minuten Thüringen? liefert unterhaltsame und tiefgründige Einblicke in den politischen Alltag und zeigt dabei mitunter auch eine andere Seite der Politik. Freuen Sie sich auf offene Gespräche, aktuelle Analysen und persönliche Anekdoten ? für alle, die Thüringen und seine Macher besser verstehen wollen.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona 's May ag argamaid, 's an dithis aca den bheachd gur iad as luaithe. Tha iad a cur romhpa rèis an aghaidh a chèile son co-dhùnadh a dhèanamh ach chan e Oona neo May a tha buannachadh aig deireadh an là ach farpaiseach mi-choltach! Oona and May get into an argument, both believing that they are faster than the other. They decide to race one another to see who is right, but they both end up being beaten by an unlikely competitor.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha droch stoirm ag adhbharachadh bùrach uabhasach. Tha Oona 's Baba a cuideachadh le bhith sgioblachadh nuair a chi iad g' eil an t-s ide air Silky fhàgail àrd am measg nan creagan, gun dòigh faighinn air ais dhan fhairge 's gu teaghlach. A wild storm leaves puffin rock in a bit of a mess. As Oona and Baba prepare to help clean it up, they discover that the weather and high tides have left Silky stranded on the cliff with no way back to sea and her family.

programme.title: Peataichean/Pets
programme.desc: Sreath ùr anns a bheil Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ coinneachadh ri clann òga agus a’ faighinn a-mach ciamar a tha iad a’ coimhead às dèidh agus a’ cluiche cuide rim peataichean aig an taigh. Anns a’ phrògram seo, tha Eilidh a’ cèilidh air Florence agus a gearra-mhucan. ‘S e Buttercup is Bluebell na h-ainmean a th’ orra agus tha iad beag agus bòidheach. Gheibh sinn a-mach barrachd mu bhith a’ coimhead às dèidh gearra-mhucan agus mu na rudan snog is spòrsail a bhios Florence, Buttercup is Bluebell a’ dèanamh còmhla. Gheibh sinn cuideachd comhairle agus fiosrachadh bho Eilidh fhèin mu bhith a’ làimhseachadh, ag oideachadh agus a’ coimhead às dèidh peataichean. Eilidh visits Florence and her gorgeous guinea pigs, Buttercup and Bluebell. We find out how to look after guinea pigs and all the lovely stuff Florence, Buttercup and Bluebell get up to together. Eilidh also shares fun and interesting facts along with advice on how best to handle, train and feed pets.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha na h-Abadas air bothan a dhèanamh anns an taigh agus a' faighinn tòrr spòrs bho bhith cluich anns an uisge. Tha facal an là-an-diugh co-cheangailte ri cumail tioram, cuideachd. Dè th'ann agus càite an lorg iad e? The Abadas have made a den inside the house and are having a lot of fun playing in the rain. Today's word has something to do with keeping dry, too. What could it be and where will they find it?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Catriona Nic a’ Phì a’ leughadh Edie. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Sophy Henn agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Morag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Catriona MacPhee reads Edie, written and illustrated by Sophy Henn and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Nuair nach eil fear a’ ghiotàr 'son cluich as a' chòmhlan aig Mìcheal aig seotha tàlant na sgoil’, tha Stella a' gabhail àit'. An dùil am bi i soirbheachail? When the guitar player doesn’t want to play in Mìcheal’s band at the school talent show, Stella takes his place. Will she be successful?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Tha Stella ’son na Bànrigh a chuideachadh. Tha i airson gum bi i a’ dèanamh rudeigin àbhaisteach, mar gum bi i na ball den Chlub Leabhair. Ach, dè cho àbhaisteach sa tha e nuair a tha a’ Bhànrigh a' dol ann? Stella wants to help the Queen. She wants her to do something normal, like becoming a member of the Book Club. But how normal is it when the Queen attends?

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Tha Lan na sgìthear saor-stoidhleach ach feumaidh e ròghnachadh an e cur-seachad proifeiseanta a th’ ann neo nach e. 'S e amas am bliadhna an co-fharpais nàiseanta a bhuannachadh. Lan is a free-style skier but he must decide if he wants it to be a professional pastime or not. His ambition this year is to win the national competition.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha sìth eadar Sebastian is Camshron cudromach an-diugh gus am fàs Gabriel nas fheàrr – agus gus am faigh iad mathanas bhuaithe cuideachd! Peace is very important between Sebastian and Cameron today so that Gabriel gets better - and earn his forgiveness also!

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Nuair a lorgas an tuathanach gu bheil pìoban ag aoidion, tha e a' cur fios air a' Bhòrd Uisge. Ach fiùs am measg nan duilgheadasan a tha seo, tha an treud a' faicinn cothrom airson beagan fealla-dha! When the farmer discovers he's sprung a leak, he calls the water board to come and fix the problem. The bored flock are thrilled by the opportunity to have some watery fun. When the workmen clock off, the party begins!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Cumaidh Bircher Muesli a’ dol thu fad na maidne, agus air a stòradh sa frids, faodar a chumail airson latha no dhà! A Bircher muesli will keep you going all morning, and by being stored in the fridge it will stretch for a few days! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Drama Gàidhlig stèidhichte ann an Leòdhas. Gaelic soap set on the Isle of Lewis.

programme.title: An Cuan Sgith (The Minch)
programme.desc: Anne Lundon goes in search of stories and people connected to the famous stretch of sea, known as The Minch. From the west coast mainland of Scotland to the easterly coast of the Hebrides, Anne discovers how the rich culture of our coastal waters are always evolving, and kept alive by those who live beside them. Tha Anne Lundon a’ sireadh sgeulachdan agus daoine ceangailte ris a mhuir ainmeil, a’ Chuain Sgìth – bhon chost an iar tìr-mòr na h-Alba, gu costa sear Innse Gall. Tha Anne a lorg mur a tha beartas nan cladaichean againn ag atharrachadh, s’air an cumail beo leis an sluagh tha fuireach ri’n taobh. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Niall Iain Macdonald hosts a quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Standing in the way of our two teams winning are the Pretenders, who, from the comfort of their own homes, are on a mission to fox our contestants. Which of this week’s teams, Seumas and Mairi or Ceit and Eilidh, will get the upper hand and have a chance to take home the grand prize? Niall Iain Dòmhnallach le farpais cheist ùr far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Tha na Mas Fhìoraich a’ gabhail pàirt bhon dachaighean ’s ag amas air a’ chùis a dhèanamh air an dà sgioba. Cò aca bho sgiobaidhean na seachdain-sa, Seumas & Mairi no Ceit & Eilidh, a gheibh làmh an uachdar agus cothrom fhaighinn air an duais mhòr? In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Valtos | Aig a’ Mhullach
programme.desc: Ceòl dannsa aig mullach a’ Chùirn Ghuirm, le na DJs Gàidhealach Valtos a’ toirt an cuid chiùil gu ìre eile le seata ciùil slàn, High Water Mark. Ceòl gun sgur bhon ùrlar-dannsaidh as àirde ann an Alba. Thig cuide ri Martyn, Dan agus Euan is iad a’ dèanamh ùrlar-dannsaidh à Stèisean Tàrmagain. Le ceòl bho Bicep, Charles J, Le Boom, Mylo, Oliver Heldens am measg eile, is cuideachd, Valtos fhèin. Dance floor fillers on top of Cairngorms as Highland DJs Valtos present High Water Mark, taking their music to new heights. In a pure, uninterrupted DJ set, join Martyn, Dan and Euan as they transform the iconic Ptarmigan Station into the highest dance floor in Scotland. Featuring tracks from Bicep, Charles J, Le Boom, Mylo and Oliver Heldens, as well as Valtos. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Runrig - The Last Dance
programme.desc: 50,000 neach-leantainn a’ dèanamh air Sruighlea gus ciurm-ciùil slàn Runrig 2018 fhaicinn, a’ comharrachadh deireadh cùrsa-beatha soirbheachail 45-bliadhna. 50,000 fans descend on Stirling to watch much-loved Scottish rock band Runrig’s 2018 poignant farewell concert, marking the end of a successful 45-year career.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing Simply Provence
programme.desc: There is one beautiful thing that the British and the French have in common, and that’s the pride taken in local dishes. But can the French persuade Marcus that there’s a local lamb dish to rival his beloved Lancashire hotpot? Marcus’s time in Saint-Remy is nearly at an end, and if there's one thing he’s learnt, it's when it comes to food, keep it simple. Now, he’s been invited to a local farm party, but the catch is he has to bring a dish - so he needs inspiration for a celebratory but simple recipe to say farewell to all the friends he’s made in Provence.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: The south Wales valleys are the setting of the final outing for best pals Margie Cooper and Tim Medhurst. They head towards Cardiff in their electric-powered former fire engine. Hitting the shops, our pair summon the support of the spirits with a pottery obelisk and some spooky psychic sketches. We learn a secret 19th-century language as one antique fan finds an antique, um, fan. In Brynmawr, Margie finds out about the life and attire of legendary wrestler Adrian Street, while Tim steps into the ring and learns not to grapple with the Welsh the hard way. At their final auction 'slam-down', will it be Tim or Margie who ends up on the mat?

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Jacqui is in Westcliff-on-Sea in Essex to look at a two-bedroom maisonette bought by a mother-and-son developing team. Martin is in Coleford, Gloucestershire, near the Forest of Dean, to see a flat in real need of renovation. And Dion is just south of Stoke-on-Trent in Barlaston to see a three-bedroom end-of-terrace bought to become a new family home.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Danny Sebastian makes sure both teams are on the right track on today’s episode from Oswestry Showground. Roo Irvine is guiding the red team, siblings Chris and Sally. Their opponents in blue are self-confessed ‘drama queens’ Valerie and Wanda, skippered by Colin Young. The blues spot a giant set of scales, and Colin volunteers to weigh himself – but it’s the price that turns out to be hefty! Meanwhile, Sally sniffs out a possible deal on an incense jar, but Roo doubts it will make a profit at auction. Near Oswestry, Danny visits a unique collection of monorails at a light railway, including one that appeared in a villain’s lair in a James Bond movie! Over the border in Wales, auctioneer Matthew Tong is on the rostrum, doing his best to help the teams make a profit. Who will be going home with money in their pockets?

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Mehreen Baig, Clare Balding, Jamie Laing and Mike Wozniak take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games reusable coffee mug, which is brand new for this series?

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and his sidekick Sarah Greene host this quiz show, where the contestants race on moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers stop them in their tracks. Five contestants battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races, where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: Vernon Kay hosts the final day of the week’s whistlestop tour of the UK. EastEnders star Nitin Ganatra, the Rev Kate Bottley and Alex Gray, aka Apollo from Gladiators, are this week’s players, and this is their final chance to claim glory. As ever, Paul Gorton is the unreliable tour guide, and he’s taking the players to Wrexham.

programme.title: The Great Rift: Africa's Wild Heart
programme.desc: Visible from space, Africa's Great Rift Valley runs three thousand miles from the Red Sea to the mouth of the Zambezi. It's a diverse terrain of erupting volcanoes, forest-clad mountains, spectacular valleys, rolling grasslands, huge lakes and mighty rivers, and is home to crocodiles, hippos, lions, elephants, flocks of flamingos and a diversity of indigenous peoples. Using state-of-the-art high definition filming techniques, this series investigates the geological forces which shaped east Africa's Great Rift and which make it one of the world's most wildlife-rich landscapes. The Great Rift Valley channels a huge diversity of waterways - rivers, lakes, waterfalls, caustic springs and coral seas - from Egypt to Mozambique. Some lake and ocean deeps harbour previously unseen life-forms, while caustic waters challenge life to the extreme. But where volcanic minerals enrich the Great Rift's waterways, they provide the most spectacular concentrations of birds, mammals and fish in all Africa.

programme.title: The Great Rift: Africa's Wild Heart
programme.desc: Visible from space, Africa's Great Rift Valley runs three thousand miles from the Red Sea to the mouth of the Zambezi. It's a diverse terrain of erupting volcanoes, forest-clad mountains, spectacular valleys, rolling grasslands, huge lakes and mighty rivers, and is home to crocodiles, hippos, lions, elephants, flocks of flamingos and a diversity of indigenous peoples. Using state-of-the-art high definition filming techniques, this series investigates the geological forces which shaped east Africa's Great Rift and which make it one of the world's most wildlife-rich landscapes. The Great Rift Valley provides the stage for an epic battle between trees and grass - its course influenced by volcanic eruptions, landscape and rainfall. On its outcome rests the fate of Africa's great game herds. In the rift's savannas, grazers and their predators struggle to outwit each other, forcing one group of primates to develop a social system that paved the way for the evolution of mankind.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents the show in which members of the public are invited to bring along their antiques for examination. At Renishaw Hall in Derbyshire finds include a collection of bronzes bought on the internet, a portrait by Stanley Spencer, and fine examples of pottery. Sir Reresby Sitwell takes a close look at what is purported to be Robin Hood's bow.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The show comes from Milestones Museum in Basingstoke, a place bursting with remnants from Basingstoke's industrial past. Elizabeth Talbot and James Lewis find the best antiques and collectibles to take to auction from the assembled crowd, while presenter Paul Martin visits the home of the man now considered to be the father of ecology, 18th-century naturalist Gilbert White.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Chris Bisson, Danielle Harold, Katharine Merry and Robert Webb take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted by the House of Games retro bag?

programme.title: Bear Grylls - Wild Reckoning
programme.desc: Married couple Steve and Jenny are in conflict over what house to buy. After a long career, Steve is preparing to leave the army, so for the first time in their relationship, the couple need to buy a property. However, they have very different ideas about what they want and need. The couple take on a raft-building challenge to highlight how they solve problems together. They must each then do a climb and make a leap of faith for a reward bag. Mediator Dave works with them to find out why they have struggled to resolve this issue so far. Is it really about the size of the mortgage, or is there more to it? At the end of two days in the wild, will only one of them be getting the house they want, or will they find a way to compromise?

programme.title: European Athletics Championships
programme.desc: The heptathlon continues on day five of the European Athletics Championships with the third event of seven, the shot put, kick-starting the evening session. Katarina Johnson-Thompson and Jade O’Dowda represent Great Britain in Birmingham, with Ireland’s Kate O’Connor another contender for gold. The women’s 10,000m also gets underway on the track, with Megan Keith part of the team after winning European bronze two years ago. Gabby Logan is alongside Jessica Ennis Hill and Greg Rutherford in the studio. Commentary comes from Steve Cram, Steve Backley, Andrew Cotter, Colin Jackson and Paula Radcliffe.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the drought takes its toll on Longmeadow, Monty takes stock of his garden and has a radical rethink about what he should be growing in the future. With this in mind, he takes cuttings of some drought-resistant plants as a way of saving money. There is also a rambling rose in desperate need of a haircut and lots of produce to harvest in the veg garden, so as always, there is plenty to be getting on with. Frances Tophill visits the picturesque village of Clovelly in north Devon, where gardening on a clifftop is not without its challenges. And in Norfolk, Adam Frost explores a walled kitchen garden steeped in history but planted with a modern eye. On the Isle of Wight, a couple tell the incredible story of how they’ve reimagined the Victorian garden of the poet Alfred, Lord Tennyson, while a gardener in East Anglia showcases his love of naturalistic planting.

programme.title: Bergerac
programme.desc: Arthur Wakefield is ready to throw Julien to the wolves, when there’s a shocking revelation about the night of Cate’s murder that changes everything. Bergerac is blown off course until he makes a major breakthrough in the search for Cate’s missing phone and he feels like he is about to close back in on his chief suspect. But with Bergerac’s behaviour becoming increasingly erratic, will he even be able to continue the investigation? Meanwhile, Arthur Wakefield is drawn to even more extreme measures to stop him.

programme.title: Unser Land
programme.desc: Unser Land - Themen: Immer angebunden: wie schwierig eine Auszeit für Tierhalter ist Der Erste im Dorf: Ein Landwirt macht Urlaub 1975 Urlaub am Bauernhof: Camping neben dem Stall Urlaubsretter in der Landwirtschaft: Betriebshelfer vom Maschinenring Kinderarbeit in den Ferien: Bulldog fahren statt Freibad Technischer Fortschritt 1969: Ballenladegeräte erleichtern Feldarbeit Unter dem Titel "Für Hof und Garten" startete der Vorläufer des Magazins 1964 im bayerischen Rundfunk. programme.desc: Auf Schlemmertour in der Rhön - Menü: Lammrücken im Schwarzbrotmantel an Selleriepüree mit Kartoffelkrapfen (Restaurant Braunsmühle, Bischofsheim in der Rhön) Biergulasch mit Brezelknödeln und Krautsalat (Berggasthof Elisäus, Bischofsheim in der Rhön) Rhön-Saibling mit Pfifferlings-Graupen-Gremolata Beurre blanc (Landgasthof Zum Weißen Rössl, Stralsbach) Mehlklöße mit Gurkensalat (Die Schmiede, Bad Neustadt (Saale) Mit Volldampf in die Geschichte Unterfrankens geht es für das "Landgasthäuser"-Team mit dem "Rhön-Zügle" und seiner historischen Lokomotive. Im Freilandmuseum Fladungen wird das Dorfleben früherer Zeiten lebendig. Hier kann man auch Speisen kosten, die damals auf den Tisch kamen - wie die traditionelle ...

programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc: Tagesschau - Seit 1952 wird die Nachrichtensendung präsentiert. Sie informiert täglich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft, Kultur und Sport. Die Sendung bietet einen kompakten und verlässlichen Überblick über das nationale und internationale Geschehen. Reporterinnen und Reporter sowie Korrespondentinnen und Korrespondenten berichten aus dem In- und Ausland und ordnen aktuelle Entwicklungen verständlich und fundiert ein. Neben den aktuellen Nachrichten werden Hintergründe, Zusammenhänge und Einordnungen vermittelt, die das Geschehen in einen größeren Kontext setzen. Dabei steht eine präzise, sachliche und unabhängige Berichterstattung im Mittelpunkt.

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Pony am Stock - Hubert (Christian Tramitz) und Girwidz (Michael Brandner) machen in einer Scheune einen grausigen Fund: Die Leiche des Gestütbesitzers ist mit einer Heugabel an die Wand genagelt. Indessen hat Sabine Kaiser Besuch von ihrer Nichte. Die ist nicht mehr ganz so klein ist, wie sie dachte. Riedls Dienstfahrrad wurde gestohlen. Der Sohn des Gestütbesitzers Georg Dausinger wurde von Riedls Nachbar als Dieb identifiziert. Bei der Suche nach dem stark alkoholisierten Jens Dausinger, entdecken Hubert und Girwidz auf dem Heuboden des Gestüts die Leiche von Vater Georg. programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Jeder Schuss ein Treffer - Hubert (Christian Tramitz) und Girwidz (Michael Brandner) sind auf der Jagd nach einem randalierenden Keiler, der Wolfratshausen unsicher macht. Dabei stolpern sie über die Leiche des Försters Ulf Gröschel, der für die Wildschweine zuständig war. Er wurde rücklings erschossen! programme.desc: Höhepunkte aus "Für mich soll's rote Rosen hageln" - Franziska Wanningers Kabarett-Soloprogramm "Für mich soll's rote Rosen hageln" ist eine launige Hommage an die Leichtigkeit, auch wenn sie feststellen muss, dass sich Freude und Abgrund oft näherstehen als man denkt! Da meint man - "Oh Wunder!" - dass das Leben Mords was für einen bereithält und am Ende ist es doch wieder bloß ein veganer Schweinsbraten. Nebenbei analysiert sie das aberwitzige Leben in Designwürfelhäusern und ihren dazugehörigen Vorgarten-Steinwüsten. Wanninger schaut den Leuten aufs Maul und singt von den Untiefen des Lebens. programme.title: Der talentierte Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Der junge Amerikaner Tom Ripley träumt vom süßen Luxusleben. Als er den Playboy Dickie im Auftrag von dessen Vater von Italien in die USA zurückbringen soll, sieht er seine Chance gekommen. Nach einem Streit tötet er Dickie und schlüpft in dessen Rolle, um als Hochstapler seinen Traum zu leben. Doch so leicht gibt David nicht auf.

programme.title: Corporate: PowerPoint des Todes
programme.desc: Matt erstellt eine beeindruckende Präsentation, um der CIA in gutem Glauben Hampton DeVilles Waffenhandel anzupreisen. Währenddessen macht sich Jake die firmeninterne Whistleblower-App zunutze.

programme.title: Corporate: Der Schmerz des Lebens
programme.desc: Nach Jakes Operation schmeicheln sich seine Kollegen bei ihm ein, in der Hoffnung, dass er seine verschreibungspflichtigen Schmerzmittel mit ihnen teilt. Den an Schlafmangel leidenden Matt verfolgen Visionen von einem Geist.

programme.title: Corporate: Trademarq
programme.desc: Hampton DeVille schließt sich mit einem Straßenkünstler zusammen, der die Firmenzentrale beschädigt hat, um Anti-Konzern-Merchandise zu verkaufen und von den Gegnern zu profitieren.

programme.title: Corporate: Firmen-Klausur
programme.desc: Auf der Firmen-Klausur von Hampton DeVille bringen Business-Gurus Matt bei, wie man selbstsicherer wird. Jake findet Liebe bei einer Networking-Party.

programme.title: Corporate: Casual Friday
programme.desc: Matt und Jake haben Mühe, einen Kollegen zu überzeugen, am Casual Friday ein Hemd zu tragen, und Christian bemüht sich, mit einer Gruppe von Megakirchen einen Handel abzuschließen.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Es gibt Matsch und Chaos in der neuen Staffel von 'Takeshi’s Castle'. Einhundert neue Kandidaten stellen sich der verrückten Bienenwabe und der Rutschwand, bevor sie die Burg stürmen können. Roman Kemp moderiert.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während 100 Kandidaten Herausforderungen wie die lustige Rutschwand bezwingen, um die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen. Haben sie das Zeug, die Wachen zu besiegen und den Sieg für sich zu beanspruchen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während sich eine brandneue Gruppe von Kandidaten durch völlig bekloppte Aufgaben kämpft, um die Burg von Takeshi einzunehmen. Die Kandidaten rutschen aus und fallen hin, vor allem an der 'Rutschwand'.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Finden die Kandidaten einen Weg aus dem Wabenlabyrinth, ohne nass zu werden? 100 neue Wettstreiter versuchen, den Wachen zu entkommen und absurde Herausforderungen wie 'Strandgammler' zu bestreiten. Roman Kemp moderiert.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während die Kandidaten unter den wachsamen Augen von General Fero dem ultimativen Sieg entgegenstolpern. Hoffentlich können sie sich lang genug am Fliegenpilz festklammern, um zur Burg von Takeshi zu gelangen.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia: 506
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während die neuen Kandidaten einen wunden Po in 'Strandgammler' bekommen und sich einen Weg über das 'harte Pflaster' bahnen, bis sie die Burg von Takeshi einnehmen können.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Einhundert Kandidaten versuchen, dem Wasser (und den Dämonen) der Bienenwabe zu entkommen und riesige Kugeln im Bowlingspiel zu bezwingen. Sie wollen die Bürg stürmen und gewinnen. Wird es ihnen gelingen? Roman Kemp moderiert.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während sich einhundert mutige Kandidaten ihren Weg zur Burg von Takeshi erkämpfen. Es gibt Wasser, Matsch und fliegende Pilze. Nur die Starken schaffen es bis zur Burg.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während sich neue Kandidaten ihren Weg zur Burg von Takeshi erkämpfen. Doch wird es ihnen gelingen, trotz Rutschwand, Strandgammler und Fliegenpilz den Sieg für sich zu beanspruchen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während 100 Kandidaten Herausforderungen wie die lustige Rutschwand bezwingen, um die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen. Haben sie das Zeug, die Wachen zu besiegen und den Sieg für sich zu beanspruchen?

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Tiere
programme.desc: In dieser Folge von 'Most Ridiculous' kriegen unsere Vierbeiner mächtig etwas auf die Mütze. Schnallt euch an und macht euch bereit für die affigsten Tiermissgeschicke, die ihr je gesehen habt.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Urlauber
programme.desc: Diesmal geht es bei 'Most Ridiculous' munter auf Reisen! Zeit, ins Wasser zu springen, abzutauchen und die Lachmuskeln ordentlich in Anspruch zu nehmen.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Jobs
programme.desc: In dieser Folge sehen wir uns nach Trotteln am Arbeitsplatz um, und schauen anderen Leuten dabei zu, wie sie sich Anerkennung verdienen. Wenn auch nicht unbedingt nur für ihre Arbeit.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Kinder
programme.desc: Diesmal zeigen uns die Jüngsten, wie sie uns nicht nur wegen ihrer Niedlichkeit zum Lachen bringen können.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Körper-Pannen
programme.desc: Diesmal dreht es sich bei 'Most Ridiculous' um den menschlichen Körper – schön schreckliche jedenfalls.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Gauner
programme.desc: Heute machen sich die Bösewichter zum Horst - menschliche wie tierische.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Hunde

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Eltern
programme.desc: Most Ridiculous, die verrückteste Clipshow im Fernsehen, ist zurück. Diesmal stehen Eltern im Rampenlicht - von faulen Vätern bis hin zu tollpatschigen Müttern.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Feuerwehrhunde / Der kleinste Riese
programme.desc: Feuerwehrhunde:Ren und Stimpy werden als Feuerhunde bei der städtischen Feuerwehr angestellt. Der kleinste Riese:Stimpy kann nicht einschlafen. Darum liest er sich die Gutenachtgeschichte vom "Kleinsten Riesen" vor.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Das schwarze Loch / Stimpys Erfindung
programme.desc: Das schwarze Loch:Commander Höek und Kadett Stimpy reisen als erster Hund und erste Katze durch das tückische schwarze Loch. Stimpys Erfindung:Stimpy, der große Erfinder, bittet Ren, seine Erfindungen zu testen, u. a. Stimpys "Bleib oben-Socken".

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Haben oder nicht haben / Vorsicht, bissiger Pavian
programme.sub-title: Haben oder nicht haben / Vorsicht, bissiger Pavian
programme.desc: Stimpy wird von einem Glibber-Verkäufer bedrängt. Irgendwann kann er sich nicht mehr zurückhalten und kauft dem aufdringlichen Kerl den ganzen Glibber ab. / Ren und Stimpy haben sich ein paar köstliche Leckerbissen gesichert: schweinebacken.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Zirkusliliputaner / Nackte Tatsachen
programme.desc: Ren und Stimpy halten den Daumen in den Wind und trampen. Schließlich werden sie von Liliputanern mitgenommen, die in einem Zirkus arbeiten. // Sie werden in ein winziges Clownauto gesperrt und sehen wahnwitzigen Abenteuern entgegen.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Ein Traum wird wahr / Lincolns Geheimnis
programme.sub-title: Ein Traum wird wahr / Lincolns Geheimnis
programme.desc: Rens Traum von Brustmuskeln wird wahr, in dem ihm Stimpy Fett aus seinem Hintern spendet. // Auf einer Schatzsuche öffnet Ren den Kopf des Lincoln Memorials. Jetzt müssen die beiden den Kopf reparieren bevor Seargent Big Butt Wind davon bekommt.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Jiminy Grillfleisch / Barschmeister
programme.desc: Stimpy unternimmt einen verzweifelten Versuch, um Ren von seinen schlechten Manieren zu befreien, indem er ihn mit seinem Gewissen bekannt macht - doch das wird verkörpert vom Gitarre spielenden Grobian Jiminy Grillfleisch.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Rentner Ren
programme.desc: Rens zehnter Geburtstag steht an. Ren ist stark und energetisch. Doch als Stimpy ihn erinnert, dass er in Hundejahren 70 ist, wird Ren zu einem verrückten alten Wasserhuhn.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Der Bauchnabelkobold / Rettung auf Rädern
programme.desc: Als er sich in seinen Bauchnabel wagt, trifft Stimpy den verrückten Bauchnabelelfen Jerry. //Als sie in der Wüste feststecken, kommen Ren & Stimpy endlich ins Wohnmobil von Mr. und Mrs. Pipe.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Der Karriereknick

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: 2026 WORLD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE CONFERENCE SPECIAL | China’s Vision for AI Development and Global Governance
programme.desc: The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) will conclude on 20th July in Shanghai. Join CGTN Biztalk on July 20 as it invites conference participants, industry observers and researchers to discuss the outcomes of the conference, and look into how China leverages WAIC as a premier industrial platform to foster dialogue, bridge divides, and promote shared governance.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc: Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy. We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations. One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays. At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward. In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future. Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.title: Policy push brings smart homes into everyday life
programme.desc: China has expanded and upgraded its dual-new policy package, marking the first-ever inclusion of smart home products in central government consumption subsidies. CGTN reporter He Jingyi explores the Beijing Premium Housing Tech Expo, testing out smart home systems with voice control and automatic sensory adjustment. She also visits offline Suning stores, speaking with outlet managers and customers to uncover how smart home solutions are gaining mainstream traction, entering ordinary households, and driving the upgrade of China’s manufacturing industry.

programme.title: Behind CXMT IPO and China’s chip roadmap
programme.desc: As CXMT makes its market debut on Shanghai's STAR Market, the listing is drawing attention far beyond the trading floor. As China's top DRAM producer, CXMT sits at the center of the country's push to strengthen its semiconductor capabilities and build a more resilient technology ecosystem. What does the IPO mean for investors, the capital market, and the future of the global memory-chip industry? Join us on BizTalk as we explore market forces, policy priorities and the roadmap to technology self-reliance behind the landmark listing.

At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward. In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future. Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.title: Behind CXMT IPO and China’s chip roadmap

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: Who are we: Graduation exhibition at CAFA explores identity and connection
programme.desc: In an age of social media, AI and constant self-presentation, young people around the world are increasingly being asked who they are and how they want to be seen. At this year's Central Academy of Fine Arts graduation exhibition in Beijing, student works are exploring exactly those questions… in deeply personal ways.

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China’s east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China’s largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess’s birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune. We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

programme.title: Who are we: Graduation exhibition at CAFA explores identity and connection
programme.desc: In an age of social media, AI and constant self-presentation, young people around the world are increasingly being asked who they are and how they want to be seen. At this year's Central Academy of Fine Arts graduation exhibition in Beijing, student works are exploring exactly those questions… in deeply personal ways.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China’s east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.desc: Established in the 14th century, Pingyao retains the typical layout of the county-level cities of the Han people in Central China. The ancient city is a complete community comprising walls, streets and lanes, shops, houses and temples.?As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Pingyao remains a testament to traditional Chinese urban planning and architecture, attracting visitors from around the world who seek to explore its historical streets and vibrant history.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Qingdao: The Jade Island
programme.desc: To boost Qingdao’s international‑oriented publicity and build its profile as an international tourist city, this episode takes us to Qingdao. Through three segments‑‑Modern Qingdao, Historic Qingdao and Internationalized Qingdao, we showcase the diverse facets of this charming city.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.
